snippet.title: The Evil School - Demo Released!
snippet.description:
Hey, there!❤️
Our game demo - an Asian FMV - has been Released!!! The demo now supports 14 languages:  Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Polish, Turkish, Thai, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese!!!

Steam Page:
store.steampowered.com/app/3818020/
